artworks.title: Ragotin enivré par La Rancune
artworks.medium: black and white chalk heightened with white and with touches of brush and black ink on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals in historical attire inside a room. The central figure, seated on a chair, wears a wide-brimmed hat and long hair, with a long coat. Another figure is partially visible to the left, drawing a curtain near the fireplace. A third person, to the seated figure's left, is standing, holding the chair. The room features tall beds, a wooden stool, a fireplace with a glowing fire, and unadorned walls.

artworks.title: L'Arrivee de l'Operateur dans l'hotellerie
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white chalk on blue laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of riders on horseback at the entrance of a building. The drawing shows two figures on horses, with a small monkey on the shoulder of one rider. The horses are in front of an arched doorway of a stone building. Some pedestrians are interacting with the riders. The architecture includes large windows, rooftops, and chimneys in the background. Light and shadow are depicted with detailed pencil strokes.

artworks.title: Ragotin dans le coffre
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white chalk on blue laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior room with period furnishings. The image depicts a room with various pieces of furniture such as a bed with a canopy, a chair, and a chest. The scene captures an elaborate room with intricate details. A canopy bed is partially visible on the left side, and an ornate mirror hangs on the wall near a large window with multiple panes, partially open. The furniture includes a high-backed chair with fabric draped over it, positioned beside a large decorative chest. The drawing reflects an 18th-century setting with rich details capturing the textures and lighting within the space. The scene is composed using a combination of light and dark shading to create depth.

artworks.title: La Rancune en brancard, abattu dans le bourbier
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white chalk on blue laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene involving horses, riders, and a carriage in motion. One horse is rearing up with its rider hanging on. The background includes trees and a winding path. The drawing utilizes shading to create emphasis and movement.

artworks.title: Peasants Carrying Sticks (Paysannes portant des fagots)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures carrying bundles on a rural path. The scene depicts an agrarian landscape with figures walking along a path carrying large bundles. The environment is rural, containing farm animals such as cows grazing in a field to the left. The path appears to wind through lightly vegetated fields with clusters of trees or bushes in the distance.

artworks.title: Peasants Carrying Sticks (Paysannes portant des fagots)
artworks.medium: lithograph (zinc) on pink Chine colle paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of individuals walking along a countryside path carrying bundles. The scene depicts a rural landscape with fields and a path where several figures appear to be engaged in agricultural activity, likely carrying sheaves of wheat or similar crops on their backs. The figures are dressed in simple, modest garments. The drawing uses a combination of dark, bold strokes and softer shading, giving texture to the figures and the surrounding landscape. The path they walk on is worn and slightly uneven. The background features fields extending toward a horizon with a line of darker shading hinting at distant trees or a wooded area. The composition captures a sense of movement and daily life in a pastoral setting.

artworks.title: Der Tod als Freund (Death as a Friend)
artworks.medium: wood engraving on wove paper [fourth edition]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a hooded figure and a reclining figure in a room. The image depicts a hooded and robed figure standing near an open archway where the sun is visible. The room is rustic, with wooden beams, a simple window, and sparse furnishings. Another figure is reclining in a high-backed chair, with items like a book and a plate of food on a table beside them. The room includes everyday items such as a jug, cup, hat, and cane. The German text "Der Tod als Freund" is visible, meaning "Death as a Friend."

artworks.title: Der Tod als Erwürger (Death as a Strangler)
artworks.description: Printed with black lines and shading on almond-white paper, a skeleton stands among three prone bodies and plays two human bones like a violin in this vertical wood engraving. At the center of the composition, the skeleton wears a long, hooded robe tied around the waist with a rope. It stands with one foot crossed in front of the other with its ear bent to the bone used as a fiddle. Two men and a woman lie on the floor around him. The woman wears a domino covering her eyes and a low-cut gown, and one man’s full-face grinning mask has slipped down. One fists grips the fabric of his pants, and his toes are curled. A third person dressed as a jester lies collapsed on hands and knees. On a platform on a stage, a person dressed as a skeleton or a mannequin sits wearing a robe and Egyptian khat, a shoulder-length cloth headdress, and holds a three-tailed flail. Three people in the shadows beyond this figure lunge to our right, presumably fleeing. Four men dressed in tunics and leggings and carrying musical instruments rush from the left platform through an open door in the upper left. Three turn to look at the skeleton and bodies with open mouths while the fourth holds his nose with his cloak. An inscription in Gothic lettering in the bottom center margin reads, “Der Tod als Erwürger.”

artworks.title: Hercules and Antaeus
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two intertwined figures in an embrace with a city and mountainous landscape in the background. The image depicts two muscular figures in a dynamic pose in front of a large tree, with a city and mountains in the distance. At their feet lie a shield and sword, reinforcing the impression of a combat scene. The style of the drawing suggests close attention to anatomical details and a sense of drama through the expressions and positions of the figures.

artworks.title: Hercules and the Nemean Lion
artworks.description: The image shows a man wrestling a lion in a forest setting. The drawing illustrates a scene of intense physical engagement between the man and the lion. The level of detail in the drawing highlights the textures of fur, skin, and the surrounding natural environment. The background features trees and foliage, creating a sense of wilderness. The use of fine lines and shading techniques conveys movement and dynamism in the interaction between the man and the lion.

artworks.title: The Death of Hercules
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological scene. A powerful male figure is surrounded by flames and clouds. The central figure is muscular, with one arm raised to the heavens and the other extending outwards. Swirling clouds and rising flames emanate from the ground. His face is expressive, turned upward. Various symbolic elements such as a coiled book, a staff, and a lyre are visible below him. The detailed engraving style with hatching and cross-hatching provides texture and depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Hercules Carrying Off the Cattle of Geryon
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a muscular figure interacting with bulls in a wooded area. The drawing depicts a muscular, nude male figure standing between two large bulls, holding them by the horns. The figure has curled hair and a focused expression. The scene is set against a backdrop of stylized trees with thick trunks and swirling clouds. In the lower left corner, there is a small plant with a few leaves and blossoms, as well as a stick or staff lying on the ground. The illustration is intricately detailed with fine lines creating a sense of texture and movement throughout the composition.

artworks.title: The Griffin
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 10.1 x 9.7 cm (4 x 3 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a fantastical creature. It combines features from multiple animals and resembles mythical beings often found in medieval art. The creature has a quadruped body with strong hind limbs, winged front limbs, a feathered neck, a bird-like head with a large beak and comb, fierce eyes, and a serpentine tail. The drawing shows detailed line work that emphasizes the creature's menacing and mythical nature.

artworks.title: Trabrennen I
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a horse pulling a cart with a person and another horse's head drawn separately. The drawing features a simple sketch using minimal lines to depict a scene where a horse is harnessed to a cart on which a person is seated. The horse appears to be in motion, as indicated by its extended legs. Off to the right side, there is a separate depiction of a horse's head. The entire composition is created using light pencil or charcoal lines on a blank background.

artworks.title: Trabrennen II
artworks.description: The image is a sketch featuring two partial profiles of a man. Both profiles show the man from the shoulders up, facing to the left. In the top sketch, the man has a prominent nose, a mustache, and curly hair under a wide-brimmed hat. The lower sketch also features the man in a similar hat with a rough line depiction of facial features including a mustache. Both sketches are bordered by rough lines at the bottom and top, resembling a railing or fence. In the background of the top sketch, there is an abstract sketch of a crowd, depicted with minimal lines. The background of the image is a plain light-colored canvas or paper. No jewelry or objects are present in the image.

artworks.title: Trabrennen III
artworks.description: The image features a sketch viewed from a direct, frontal perspective. A small figure is on the left side holding a rope tied to an animal, likely a bull, positioned slightly to the right. There is no evident horizon line. The drawing occupies a modest section of the center of a predominantly bare canvas, emphasizing the central action. The brushstrokes are minimal and concise, characterized by delicate, fine lines that denote simplicity and a quick sketch technique. The color palette is monochromatic, with a light gray for the canvas and darker gray pencil lines for the details of the figure and bull, creating a subtle visual contrast against the pale background.

artworks.title: Trabrennen IV
artworks.description: This is a drawing of horses in motion, featuring sketches of horses and a horse-drawn carriage in quick, gestural strokes. The horses are depicted with minimal lines, capturing a sense of fluidity and dynamism. The use of simple lines suggests an unfinished quality, emphasizing motion and anatomy. The background is left empty, focusing on the figures in motion.

artworks.title: Trabrennen V
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting horse-drawn carriages and individuals gathered in a public setting. The drawing shows a carriage drawn by horses in the foreground, with outlined figures dispersed around and in the vicinity of the carriages. Some figures are standing aside, while others appear to be observing or engaged in an activity. The background and foreground are lightly rendered, creating an ethereal quality with a focus on motion and ambiance. The sparse and airy style emphasizes a sense of momentary observation, in a soft and impressionistic approach.

artworks.title: Trabrennen VI
artworks.description: The image displays soft, dark lines and shapes forming an abstract scene. The lines resemble a crowd of people with oval-shaped heads and body outlines. Some horizontal lines above suggest an abstract horizon or boundary. The composition evokes a sense of a group gathering or assembly, depicting multiple individuals in a bustling environment.

artworks.title: Trabrennen VII
artworks.description: This image shows a scene with a horse statue in a bustling event setting. The artwork portrays a lively atmosphere in an outdoor setting with a crowd around the statue. A cityscape forms the backdrop, with minimal lines used to depict people and buildings. The style conveys motion and energy, focusing on capturing the essence of the gathering rather than detailed human figures.

artworks.title: Trabrennen VIII
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene showing figures in motion. The image includes a group of figures in motion, possibly on horseback along a curved path or arena. In the foreground, there are smaller figures in a dense gathering, with some abstracted shapes that could represent a landscape or setting. The artwork uses minimalistic line work to convey motion and focus.

artworks.title: Trabrennen IX
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people standing closely together. The scene is sketched in a loose, impressionistic style with simple lines and shading to show the figures. Many appear to be wearing long coats and hats. Some figures are more defined than others, and the background is largely blank.

artworks.title: Trabrennen X
artworks.description: This is an image of a group of horses and riders in a sketch-like style. The artwork features minimalistic lines and a light background, suggesting motion and activity. The composition includes a structure in the background.

artworks.title: Trabrennen XI
artworks.description: The image shows a collection of delicate, wispy lines converging and meandering across the canvas. The lines form an abstract representation within the central area of a mostly empty field, hinting at the form of a galloping horse. The curves suggest legs in motion and the faint outline of a flowing mane. These elements evoke the image of a horse in fluid movement in an abstract style.
